<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">
<!-- Permisos necesarios para la aplicación --> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" /> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" /> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK" /> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WAKE_LOCK" /> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />
<application android:allowBackup="true" android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules" android:fullBackupContent="@xml/backup_rules" android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher" android:label="@string/app_name" android:roundIcon="@mipmap/ic_launcher_round" android:supportsRtl="true" android:theme="@style/Theme.Castafiore" android:usesCleartextTraffic="true">
<!-- Actividad de splash (launcher) --> <activity android:name=".ui.activities.SplashActivity" android:exported="true" android:theme="@style/Theme.Castafiore"> <intent-filter> <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" /> <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" /> </intent-filter> </activity>
<!-- Actividad de configuración --> <activity android:name=".ui.activities.SetupActivity" android:exported="false" android:theme="@style/Theme.Castafiore" />
<!-- Actividad principal --> <activity android:name=".ui.activities.MainActivity" android:exported="false" android:theme="@style/Theme.Castafiore" />
<!-- Actividad de detalle de álbum --> <activity android:name=".ui.activities.AlbumDetailActivity" android:exported="false" android:theme="@style/Theme.Castafiore" />
<!-- Actividad del reproductor (pantalla completa) --> <activity android:name=".ui.activities.PlayerActivity" android:exported="false" android:theme="@style/Theme.Castafiore" android:launchMode="singleTask" android:screenOrientation="portrait" />
<!-- Actividad de cola de reproducción --> <activity android:name=".ui.activities.QueueActivity" android:exported="false" android:theme="@style/Theme.Castafiore" android:screenOrientation="portrait" />
<!-- Servicio de música --> <service android:name=".service.MusicService" android:enabled="true" android:exported="false" android:foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback" />
</application>
</manifest>

<resources xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"> <!-- Base application theme. --> <style name="Theme.Castafiore" parent="Theme.MaterialComponents.NoActionBar"> <!-- Primary brand color. --> <item name="colorPrimary">@color/primary</item> <item name="colorPrimaryVariant">@color/primary_dark</item> <item name="colorOnPrimary">@color/text_on_primary</item> <!-- Secondary brand color. --> <item name="colorSecondary">@color/secondary</item> <item name="colorSecondaryVariant">@color/secondary_dark</item> <item name="colorOnSecondary">@color/text_on_primary</item> <!-- Status bar color. --> <item name="android:statusBarColor">@color/background_primary</item> <!-- Customize your theme here. --> <!-- Colores de superficie y fondo --> <item name="android:colorBackground">@color/background_primary</item> <item name="colorSurface">@color/surface</item> <item name="colorOnSurface">@color/text_primary</item> <item name="colorSurfaceVariant">@color/surface_variant</item> <item name="colorOnSurfaceVariant">@color/text_secondary</item>
<!-- Colores de error --> <item name="colorError">@color/error</item> <item name="colorOnError">@color/white</item>
<!-- Fondo de ventana --> <item name="android:windowBackground">@color/background_primary</item>
<!-- Colores de texto --> <item name="android:textColorPrimary">@color/text_primary</item> <item name="android:textColorSecondary">@color/text_secondary</item>
<!-- Barra de estado y navegación --> <item name="android:statusBarColor">@color/background_primary</item> <item name="android:navigationBarColor">@color/background_primary</item> <item name="android:windowLightStatusBar">false</item> <item name="android:windowLightNavigationBar">false</item>
<!-- Forzar tema oscuro siempre --> <item name="android:forceDarkAllowed" tools:targetApi="q">false</item>
<!-- Contenedores --> <item name="colorPrimaryContainer">@color/surface</item> <item name="colorOnPrimaryContainer">@color/text_primary</item> <item name="colorSecondaryContainer">@color/surface_variant</item> <item name="colorOnSecondaryContainer">@color/text_primary</item>
<!-- Outline --> <item name="colorOutline">@color/outline</item>
<!-- Control destacado --> <item name="colorControlHighlight">@color/primary_light</item> <item name="colorControlActivated">@color/primary</item> <item name="colorControlNormal">@color/text_secondary</item> </style> </resources>
